ImageDescription.value:
My brother diving off a rental pontoon boat on Charleston Lake.

I've returned, mostly in once peace. I did take one spill down a hill, camera in hand... but it seems to be ok. My knee isn't...

I will say that this is one of the stupidest idea's I have ever had. I jumped in the water, told my dad to hand me the camera, and told my brother to dive in. Of course, it didn't work the first time around, but the second try worked better. Luckily I managed to NOT get the camera wet, but I won't be trying that again.

Plenty more to come...
